[h3][b]⏳ Tormentor Crowdfunding – 3 Days Left[/b][/h3][h3]We’ve officially hit our goal: [b]€30,165 raised by 437 backers[/b] – [i]100% funded on IndieGoGo[/i].[/h3][p]Thank you to everyone who believed in [i]Tormentor[/i] and helped us bring it to life without compromise. Every share, comment, and contribution got us here. We still have [b]3 days left[/b] in the campaign, and we’ll continue posting updates and previews for all of you until the very end.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]A letter from Shawnee![/b][/h3][p]And for fans of Bloody Mary, we have something special in store. [b]Shawnee Smith[/b], the legendary actress behind her, sat down to share a few thoughts on stepping into this chilling role:[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/96968006f694ef2f113326999c651c08c16cea55.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Q: How did you feel when approached with the opportunity to become Bloody Mary?[/b]
Apprehensive because it was so violent and curious to explore that anger and vengeance within me.[/p][p][b]Q: Favorite voice line to record?[/b]
“Open your mouth and say, AAAAAHHHH!!!”[/p][p][b]Q: How does your approach to acting change when performing for a video game?[/b]
Working more so with imagination as opposed to working “off of” the other actor.[/p][p][b]Q: How much of Shawnee is in Bloody Mary?[/b]
I’d never admit it publicly.[/p][p][b]Q: What are you most excited for with her release?[/b]
“Most excited for …?” Excited? I’m terrified! This is terrifying![/p][p][b]Q: If given the opportunity, what would be the one element you would add to Bloody Mary?[/b]
A better body. I’M KIDDING!! I actually care about her, so, I’d say, forgiveness, before it’s “game over.”[/p][hr][/hr][p][i]If given the opportunity, what would you ask this legendary actress? 
Bonus points if you keep it Tormentor related![/i][/p][h3]

notes.title: Ezekiel – Brutal. Silent. Relentless.
notes.content:
In the twisted world of Agony, there are no heroes, only monsters. Among them, Ezekiel stands apart. Known only as The Tormentor, he is the original executioner, the embodiment of raw power, and the silent force behind the game’s darkest acts of violence. There is no joy in his work. No flair. No theatrics. Just pain, control, and absolute dominance.

Where other killers might gloat, Ezekiel does not speak. His silence is more terrifying than words. His strength is not just physical, it is primal. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/d160d28f12dadc99170c032cdaa004701a80346d.jpg[/img][i]Ezekiel Concept, 2023[/i]

[h3]A Mind in Decay[/h3]
Beneath the surface of this unstoppable killer is a man unraveling. Ezekiel is not whole. His mind is deteriorating, gnawed away by a mysterious mental illness that clouds his memory and thoughts. Every act of violence is both a release and a cry for clarity. He is desperate to stay in control, not just of others but of himself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/3dcaed3e490f3adc8eb9a963d12958c0cff89de7.gif[/img]
To fight the madness, he relies on a potent, experimental drug supplied through a shadowy criminal network operating within the prison. This drug keeps his thoughts sharp and his instincts focused, but it comes at a price. The more he takes, the deeper the hole he digs for himself. Ezekiel is constantly fighting a war inside his head, even as he dominates everyone around him.

This inner conflict is what makes Ezekiel more than just a killer. He is a man torn between two nightmares, the one he creates and the one he lives in.

[h3]Manhunt and the Reversal of Power[/h3]
In the rare moments when prisoners are given a chance to fight back, when the hunted become the hunters, Ezekiel becomes even more terrifying. He doesn’t hide. He doesn’t panic. He fights with his bare hands, relying on instinct and sheer force to crush the uprising.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/f8f2c0a7e3873494769ab4090cd1a61cea398e90.gif[/img]

While others might retreat or outthink their pursuers, Ezekiel only charges forward. Every encounter is personal. Every act of retaliation is answered with something worse. For him, fear is not a weakness, it’s a tool he wields without speaking a word.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/45c0c665899c4af3a43f96b5338ffd30a32af023.gif[/img]

[h3]The Face of Tormentor[/h3]
Ezekiel is more than a playable character. He is the face of Tormentor. The tone of the game is built around his presence, brutality, silence, and struggle. Where Bloody Mary is theatrical and cruel, Ezekiel is efficient and inevitable. Where she talks, he kills. Where she toys, he breaks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/7a11b782a98e1d88c3870a2c9ddd0b26e96e67d3.gif[/img]

But make no mistake, Ezekiel is not a mindless beast. He is a man who remembers just enough of who he used to be to know that he has become something else entirely.
And deep down, buried beneath the madness, he knows there’s no going back.

notes.title: Bloody Mary – A killer you never SAW coming
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=dZDL2tBCKoE;full]https://youtu.be/dZDL2tBCKoE[/previewyoutube]
In Tormentor, brutality is an art, and no two artists paint their horrors the same way. Ezekiel "The Tormentor" and Bloody Mary may share a thirst for pain, but their methods, styles, and personalities set them worlds apart.

With the legendary [b]Shawnee Smith[/b] bringing Bloody Mary to life, she is more than just another executioner, she is a spectacle, a sadistic performer who thrives in the chaos of carnage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/3256986bc1b92bad576fee0a752fbfc4fff8e339.gif[/img]

[h2]The Art of Torture – Strength vs. Precision[/h2]
Every executioner has their preferred tools, and for Ezekiel, brute force reigns supreme. He revels in the raw, animalistic act of destruction, hammers, fists, teeth, and sheer overwhelming power. His kills are merciless, silent, and beastlike.

Mary, however, turns pain into a performance, accustomed to livestreams and a public view, she makes sure the crowd is entertained. Precise, elegant, and obsessed with the sight of blood. Her weapons of choice? Scalpels, sickles, and anything that slices deep. She wants her victims to bleed, suffer, and leave a trail behind them, knowing full well they have no escape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/ed4f491548fef070bcc0f1285bd4158cc0f870c5.gif[/img]

[h2]Manhunt – When the Prey Strikes Back[/h2]
When the tables turn and prisoners are given a chance to fight back, Tormentor and Mary handle the hunt differently.

Ezekiel fights like a beast, using only his hands, teeth, and a knife for executions. He doesn’t need anything else, his sheer strength is his deadliest weapon.

Mary is fast, agile, and relentless. Wielding razor-sharp sickles, she can cut down prisoners in an instant. Any victim who tries to run will leave a bloody trail, leading her straight to their hiding place.
Ezekiel breaks you, but Mary plays with you, a cat toying with its prey before the final kill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/f8faa9d77bd928a790e904d7fc121b414c7fe226.gif[/img]

[h2]Shawnee Smith is Mary[/h2]

[b]Shawnee Smith[/b], known for her unforgettable role as Amanda Young in SAW, stepping into this blood-soaked role, Mary becomes more than just a character, she’s an experience. Her delivery, mannerisms, and sadism will turn Mary into a nightmare you’ll never forget.

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/1048afc2901e508a32f77c174f191a7ec2f32097.jpg[/img][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/75cf982df39ed9bc5e7f706df2c122916b70e0d9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/34da8ff8b40b04b6081f30c81f5c7459665ec3b7.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/aacd86bf554252e46bdbd8ba5446ec007859b11b.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/a78e4f6cf3c7bd383c14cbaa668f53efab498780.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/5e46a03c27011416353e65afa179011dd4e139b8.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/1c2440ef336366935504c01d6e087ba804b3fe24.jpg[/img][/url] 
[i]Bloody Mary Concept Art[/i] - Higher Res of these images can be found on our [url=https://tinyurl.com/MadmindStudio]Discord[/url].[hr][/hr][h3]The Nightmare Begins[/h3]
With both Ezekiel and Mary in play, Tormentor delivers two distinct styles of horror, one built on raw strength and brutality, the other on precision, speed, and the art of suffering.

notes.title: News from the battle front
notes.content:
Hi,

We finally come to you with news after a long period of silence!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/04148b368599d9ce1eb2d4fb4178e24d695fc75d.png[/img]

Soon we will present you many new materials from the game, and we will also provide you with a playable prologue, which we hope will allow you to feel the brutal and cruelty (and LACK OF CENSORY) world of Tormentor, which will give you a foretaste of what you can expect from the full version of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/667b4dccb918bbb0b6b904845fdcb8261dedf65b.gif[/img]

Unfortunately, we regret to inform you that the game will not be released this year. When creating such a controversial title, we encounter many difficulties that we have to deal with. 

The premiere of our other title - Paranoid, in December 2023 was a huge blow to us and got us into very big financial difficulties, which had a significant impact on the production of Tormentor. 

In order to survive and be able to finish the game in the form we wanted, we had to significantly reduce our team, which means that we did not have enough people to finish the game on time. Some of our regular contractors refused to work on the game, so we are creating key models and animations ourselves, with our small team.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/0cbade83118f6f6aa46339d80686f992382499c8.gif[/img]

For over half a year, we talked to many different publishers, looking for help in financing the game. Unfortunately, the conversations always ended the same - "We see the potential of the project, but unfortunately our company cannot be associated with this type of content."
Additionally, one of our key investors suddenly withdrew from financing the game, which meant that we were unable to purchase previously recorded materials for the full version of the game, which effectively blocked us from working on the project. 

Thanks to recent, successful premieres of smaller productions, we have finally returned to the production of Tormentor with full commitment and determination!

And once again - thank you for your support. Over 100,000 of you are waiting for Tormentor. We are perfectly aware that you expect an uncompromising and thoroughly messed-up production, and that's what we want to provide you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/f8f2c0a7e3873494769ab4090cd1a61cea398e90.gif[/img]


And now, back to work. 

Tormentor will rise, no matter what stands in our way. 

Thanks for being with us. 


Take care,
Madmind

notes.title: MADNIGHT 2021: Horror Showcase
notes.content:
[b]Dear Players[/b],

We would like to invite you to the video presentation organized together with Rely On Horror - "MADNIGHT 2021: Horror Showcase", during which new materials from the widely understood horror games produced by Madmind Studio will be presented, with guest participation of developers from other studios.

MADNIGHT 2021: The Horror Showcase takes place [b]December 16, 2021[/b].

The entire event will be available at [url=www.relyonhorror.com]www.relyonhorror.com[/url] - one of the largest, most popular websites focused on horror games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139853/d92e8046f12eb649c01404242936cde9a3529667.jpg[/img]

MADNIGHT 2021 is [b]an event unprecedented in the gaming industry[/b], during which players will be able to get to meet the Hell Messenger for the first time - a mysterious creature with which they have been interacting for many months on our social media and Madmind Studio's Discord channel.

[b]The Hell Messenger[/b] will take viewers into a terrifying world of horror that can take many forms. Have you ever wondered what working in a crematorium looks like? What does a person with advanced paranoid schizophrenia feel and see? Or maybe you want an extreme dose of uncompromising brutality and gore? You will see all these and many other attractions soon during MADNIGHT 2021!

[b]MADNIGHT 2021 Horror Showcase will feature[/b]:

- Madmind Studio
- Black Rat
- Live Motion Games
- Lunarium Creations
- IGNIBIT
- Woodland Games

Over the past five years, Madmind Studio has become synonymous with frightening, controversial and violent games. This year's premiere of the studio's latest game, Succubus, [b]was very well received by players and critics[/b] who decided to give the game very positive recommendations.

In addition to good grades, [b]Succubus achieved great financial results[/b]. Released on October 5 2021, the game has so far made more money on Steam than the studio's previous game, Agony, in more than three years since its release.
